title: Dr. Reddy’s API at CPHI Japan 2024
summary: 在 CPhI Japan 2024 上了解 Dr. Reddy's Laboratories 的最新 API 开发和创新解决方案。随时了解我们的制药进步和行业领先技术。
body_markdown:
#### Dr. Reddy’s API at CPHI Japan 2024


Dr. Rajeev, Executive Vice President and Head of API R&D at Dr. Reddy's, recently shared invaluable insights at[CPHI Japan](https://api-events.drreddys.com/zh-hans/events/cphi-japan-2024) . His session on “Strategic advantages for Japanese companies to partner with Indian manufacturers for sustainable patient access” was both enlightening and empowering. His session was a profound exploration of the synergies between Japanese companies and Indian manufacturers, paving the way for sustainable healthcare solutions and enhanced patient access.
